title: Recording & Minutes

layer.cleanup_sub: Removes fillers and merges stutters; never deletes negations or self-corrections, meaning preserved
layer.formal_sub: Rewrites spoken language into formal prose as a separate version; verbatim transcript is never modified
layer.formal_locked_title: AI rewrite is available after the meeting
layer.formal_locked_desc: Live text is not changed during recording, avoiding latency and tone reversals. Generate it from the More menu once the meeting ends.
layer.tag_cleaned_title: View verbatim transcript and cleanup details

transcript.hide_title: Hide transcript, keep only chapters and key points
transcript.hidden_indicator: {count} transcript lines hidden, showing only chapters and key points
transcript.empty_hint: Start speaking and the recognized content will appear here in real time
transcript.local_batch_notice: Local engine mode: recording stays fully on-device with no network involved; live text is unavailable during recording, and transcription runs on this device after you stop.
transcript.local_realtime_notice: Local engine mode: segmented recognition with sentence-by-sentence display (a few seconds behind), fully on-device with no network involved.
transcript.batch_empty: Recording in progress — transcription will run on this device after you stop
transcript.batch_empty_hint: Segmented live display is off, so no live sentences appear during recording

notes.placeholder: Take notes... Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line

insights.title: Insight Deck
insights.empty: Ask AI to analyze or draw a diagram in chat; outputs will appear here
insights.empty_hint: Diagrams aid thinking and surface blind spots in the discussion

abandon_dialog.title: Abandon this recording?
abandon_dialog.desc: The recording will be terminated and all data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

volume_warning: Very low volume detected. Please check your microphone or audio input device.

presence_warning.gentle_text: No speech detected for {minutes} minutes and the page is inactive. Continue recording?
presence_warning.urgent_text: Recording has been inactive for {minutes} minutes and will stop automatically soon.
presence_warning.auto_stopped_text: Recording automatically stopped due to prolonged inactivity
